# Security Checklist: Make www.doncoleman.ca the main address

**Purpose**: Validate that hostname, transport, origin-check, token and data-handling requirements are complete and consistent.
**Created**: 2026-10-10
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md), [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-checklist`. Items test the quality of the written requirements, not the implementation.

## Hostnames and Origins

- [ ] CHK001 Is the Turnstile hostname requirement (explicit `www.doncoleman.ca`) reconciled with Cloudflare's documented root-domain coverage, and is the open question's decision recorded? [Conflict, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK002 Is it specified whether the bare domain should be removed from the widget after the swap, given it no longer serves the form? [Gap, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the same-origin requirement for `/api/*` stated against the request host for both contact and questions APIs, including behaviour for a request carrying an `Origin` of the bare domain? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK004 Are cookie, CORS or `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` requirements stated, or explicitly absent, for `www` versus the bare domain? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the preview Worker's and preview Turnstile hostname handling unchanged and stated as such, including the "fallback" host in FR-012? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012]

## Transport

- [ ] CHK006 Is the claim that the one-year HSTS with `includeSubDomains` covers `www` supported by where that header is set and by whether first-visit bare-domain redirects are exposed to downgrade? [Assumption, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the unprotected first hop over `http://doncoleman.ca` (redirect responses carry no Worker HSTS header) acknowledged as accepted risk or follow-up with a stated owner? [Gap, Plan §Risks]
- [ ] CHK008 Is a valid-certificate requirement for both hosts stated, including renewal and the bare domain's certificate for its redirect? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK009 Are HSTS preload implications of the new `www` host addressed or explicitly out of scope? [Gap]

## Setup Check and Secrets

- [ ] CHK010 Is the requirement that the "Live hosts" item sends no credentials and logs only status codes and `Location` values written in the spec, not only the plan? [Gap, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK011 Are requirements defined for redirect `Location` values pointing at untrusted hosts (the follower must not fetch off-zone targets or leak headers)? [Gap, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the read-only token's permission set documented as sufficient for the Turnstile hostname and DNS proxied-flag reads, with no widening? [Assumption, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the redirect-follower's maximum hop count and loop handling specified so a hostile or looping response cannot hang the check? [Coverage, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the requirement that no secret appears in setup-check output or docs examples stated for the new item and runbook? [Gap]

## Surface and Abuse

- [ ] CHK015 Is the exposure created by a proxied placeholder `AAAA 100::` (no origin) defined, e.g. what a non-redirected request or an unmatched path returns? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK016 Are the mail, SPF, DKIM, DMARC and CAA records protected by an explicit "unchanged" comparison requirement rather than only a statement? [Measurability, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the redirect rule specified so it cannot become an open redirect (target host fixed, path only taken from the request)? [Gap, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the contact flow after the swap (Turnstile token, origin check, email delivery) specified end to end as one acceptance condition? [Completeness, Spec §SC-005]
